payload.question: You receive a Zoom meeting invitation. Which element indicates this might be a phishing attempt?
payload.image_alt: A fake Zoom meeting invitation email
options: The 'Join Meeting' link goes to 'zoom.us.meeting-join.com' not 'zoom.us'
The meeting is scheduled for 6:00 AM
The meeting ID is 13 digits long instead of the usual 9-11
The organizer's name is not in your contacts
payload.anomaly_hint: Check the actual destination of the Join Meeting button

explanation: Real Zoom links go to 'zoom.us' or 'zoom.com'. The domain 'zoom.us.meeting-join.com' appends 'zoom.us' as a subdomain of 'meeting-join.com'. Attackers use this because email clients and users often read domains left-to-right and stop at a recognized brand name. Meeting ID length irregularities are subtle and Zoom changes their format; URL inspection is more reliable.
